instructions.name: claim
docs: Claims tokens from the [TipDistributionAccount].

accounts.name: claimStatus
docs: Status of the claim. Used to prevent the same party from claiming multiple times.

accounts.name: claimant
docs: Receiver of the funds.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Who is paying for the claim.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.merkleRootUploadAuthority} releases ${data.amount} from tip distribution account ${accounts.tipDistributionAccount} to ${accounts.claimant}, if the attached merkle proof matches the account's merkle root; ${accounts.payer} pays the rent of claim record ${accounts.claimStatus}

instructions.name: closeClaimStatus
docs: Anyone can invoke this only after the [TipDistributionAccount] has expired.
This instruction will return any rent back to `claimant` and close the account

accounts.name: claimStatusPayer
docs: Receiver of the funds.

display.interpolatedIntent: Expired claim record ${accounts.claimStatus} is closed and its rent goes back to ${accounts.claimStatusPayer}

instructions.name: closeTipDistributionAccount
docs: Anyone can invoke this only after the [TipDistributionAccount] has expired.
This instruction will send any unclaimed funds to the designated `expired_funds_account`
before closing and returning the rent exempt funds to the validator.

accounts.name: signer
docs: Anyone can crank this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} closes expired tip distribution account ${accounts.tipDistributionAccount} of epoch ${data.epoch}: unclaimed tips go to ${accounts.expiredFundsAccount} and its rent goes back to validator vote account ${accounts.validatorVoteAccount}

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Initialize a singleton instance of the [Config] account.

display.label: Epochs Until a Tip Distribution Account Expires

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.initializer} creates the program's config with authority ${data.authority}: unclaimed tips go to ${data.expiredFundsAccount}, tip distribution accounts expire ${data.numEpochsValid} epochs after their epoch, and validator commission is capped at ${data.maxValidatorCommissionBps}
${accounts.authority} lets ${data.authority} take over uploading merkle roots for every tip distribution account still set to ${data.originalAuthority} that has no root yet

instructions.name: initializeTipDistributionAccount
docs: Initialize a new [TipDistributionAccount] associated with the given validator vote key
and current epoch.

accounts.name: validatorVoteAccount
docs: The validator's vote account is used to check this transaction's signer is also the authorized withdrawer.

accounts.name: signer
docs: Must be equal to the supplied validator vote account's authorized withdrawer.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} opens tip distribution account ${accounts.tipDistributionAccount} for validator vote account ${accounts.validatorVoteAccount} for the current epoch, keeping ${data.validatorCommissionBps} commission on its tips, and lets ${data.merkleRootUploadAuthority} decide who is paid from it
The merkle root upload authority of tip distribution account ${accounts.tipDistributionAccount} moves from the original authority to the override authority set in ${accounts.merkleRootUploadConfig}

instructions.name: updateConfig
docs: Update config fields. Only the [Config] authority can invoke this.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.authority} sets the program's authority to ${data.newConfig.authority}: unclaimed tips go to ${data.newConfig.expiredFundsAccount}, tip distribution accounts expire ${data.newConfig.numEpochsValid} epochs after their epoch, and validator commission is capped at ${data.newConfig.maxValidatorCommissionBps}
${accounts.authority} lets ${data.authority} take over uploading merkle roots for every tip distribution account still set to ${data.originalAuthority} that has no root yet

instructions.name: uploadMerkleRoot
docs: Uploads a merkle root to the provided [TipDistributionAccount]. This instruction may be
invoked many times as long as the account is at least one epoch old and not expired; and
no funds have already been claimed. Only the `merkle_root_upload_authority` has the
authority to invoke.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.merkleRootUploadAuthority} sets who is paid from tip distribution account ${accounts.tipDistributionAccount}: a merkle root paying out at most ${data.maxTotalClaim} to at most ${data.maxNumNodes} recipients
